## Summary

Describe the behavior changed and why.

## Verification

List the commands or cases used to verify the change.

## Documentation checklist

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` describes every user-visible or operational change, or this
      pull request explains why no changelog entry is needed.
- [ ] The durable guide and `README.md` entry point are updated where relevant.
- [ ] New or changed commands, configuration, APIs, outputs, warnings, and
      installation paths include a verified example.
- [ ] Paths, field names, compatibility statements, and artifact names were
      checked against the implementation and tests.
